page.overview:
What is Northfarthing?

The Northfarthing (or North Farthing) was the least populated of the four Farthings of the Shire.

It was the only Farthing that did not meet at the Three Farthing Stone, as its southern point ended around eleven miles north of it.

The Northfarthing had a colder climate then the rest of the Shire, and was the only place where heavy snowfall was common.

The soil tended to be rocky, and settlements here were delved or made from its stones. It was still good enough to farm and was where the Shire's barley for their beer came from.
